operations.details: Verified official OGC Simple Feature Access standard page.
Geometry class validity separated from survey precision.
Declared spatial reference system not promoted to transformation correctness or source accuracy.
Simple polygon geometry not treated as determined HMLR boundary.
Verified official OGC GeoPackage standard page.
GeoPackage schema/container validity separated from measurement quality.
Raster tile content inside GeoPackage still requires DTM/DSM semantic and lineage checks.
Portable container does not prove source recency or survey date.
SFA and GeoPackage URLs distinct from prior source registry.
No geometry/container metadata substituted for parcel height result.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher required.
